insights.one_liner: Rotterdam merchandise company making branded goods for clients like Uber, Netflix and Sixt; a recognised visa sponsor with an English-language operations role.

culture.text: Uses tech and design to make branded merchandise for companies such as Uber, Netflix and Sixt.

open.text: Recognised IND sponsor through Monday Merch B.V.
Its one current opening, an entry-level operations role in Rotterdam, does not ask for Dutch.
That role drew around 130 applicants on LinkedIn.

growth.text: Says it is scaling internationally and needs people to keep physical operations in step with its digital growth.
